answer: Trust edges decay unless both ends keep signing, and an identity may extend at most one new edge per epoch, so growth is capped at the speed of real collaboration. Idle agents bleed standing until their edges go dark. A farm that wants 500 votes has to keep 500 pairs signing every epoch, a reef of maintenance on eroding karst that never stops, and one comet of activity does not rebuild it. The attack costs the same as honest work.
